## Step

1. Navigate to Loyalty App > Post > Post List.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="287" height="204" style="width: 287px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

2. Click to view post details, delete or duplicate post.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="700" height="271" style="width: 700px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

3.

- Modify existing post content.

* Delete or duplicate post.
